title: SEC vs FTX
tagline: SBF teaches Gary Gensler about crypto and brings him over to the dark side
description:
SBF and Gary have a conversation about POAPs, Worldcoin, Zero Knowledge and NFTs. Sam eventually convinces Gary about the usefulness of crypto but Gary is only interested in the more nefarious uses of it and becomes a believer in crypto, but on the dark side.

This was my first attempt at using visual generative AI.
how_its_made:
Various generative AI tools - sadly I didn't have enough time to turn this into a full blown animation with a clean and polished script.
